verdict.rationale: Goodwin's Founders Workbench ships Document Driver®, a free self-serve tool that generates real formation documents for a Delaware C-Corp, multi-member LLC, or single-member LLC. That is document generation, not static template downloads, so the core of the story is met. Missing for 10: no description of the interactive questionnaire or assembly flow, coverage limited to entity formation (no financing, hiring, or other documents), no independent or hands-on corroboration, and the firm's own caveat to consult advisors before use.
